candidate: Northwestern Anatolia roe deer seasonal dynamic occupancy 2008-2018

scientific_estimand.name: survey_recorded_seasonal_appearance
scientific_estimand.candidate_definition: For transition t->t+1, retain an analysis station only when source-season camera effort > 0, target-season camera effort > 0, and the source-season aggregate recorded roe-deer detection is 0.
scientific_estimand.positive_definition: Among frozen candidates, target = 1 when any non-missing monthly roe-deer count in target primary season is > 0; otherwise target = 0 when target effort > 0.
scientific_estimand.interpretation: survey-recorded seasonal appearance under positive camera effort
scientific_estimand.source_state: current recorded internal source: station has source-season effort > 0 and aggregate recorded detection = 1
scientific_estimand.process_source_closure: All reachability claims are explicitly conditional on currently recorded internal sources in the frozen 171-station universe. Undetected or external biological sources are not claimed absent; a world eliminated under this rule is incompatible only with the declared recorded-source explanation.

response_semantics.format: CSV read with first physical column as row index
response_semantics.expected_raw_station_columns: exactly the 173 station names in frozen stations.csv order before TUL08/TUL12 exclusion
response_semantics.cell_rule: each non-missing response cell must parse as a finite non-negative integer count; any count > 0 is a recorded detection
response_semantics.primary_season_mapping: five consecutive monthly rows per primary season: months 1-5 -> season 1, ..., months 106-110 -> season 22
response_semantics.season_labels: odd primary seasons are winter; even primary seasons are summer, inherited from author data-preparation code
response_semantics.post_open_unknown_schema_or_token_rule: STOP before exact count/model/scoring; no parser repair and rerun as independent evidence

effort_semantics.site_mapping: site is 1-based index in the frozen 171-station retained order after TUL08/TUL12 exclusion
effort_semantics.effort_rule: ndays must be finite and >=0; source/target season enters the appearance endpoint only when ndays>0

transition_split.interpretation: first 16 transitions calibration; final 5 transitions held out, inherited from the immediately preceding giant-kelp fresh contract rather than adapted to roe-deer outcomes

exact_count_gate.provenance: Inherited unchanged from the giant-kelp fresh complementarity contract.
exact_count_gate.failure_rule: If any minimum fails, stop with zero model fits and zero heldout scores.

layer_a.deduplication_rule: The frozen 0.90 LCC target has the same 37.290775923813-km adjacency as the 0.75 target and is not duplicated as a second scientific world.
layer_a.support_definition: For each world/node/transition before target response is used, support is the fraction of current recorded source stations whose frozen UTM distance to the node is <= that world's threshold.
layer_a.calibration_update: After scoring/building features for a calibration transition, eliminate each surviving world if any positive survey-recorded appearance in that target season has support <= 0 under that world.
layer_a.heldout_update: For each heldout transition, create predictions using the surviving set before target outcome; only after scoring that outer unit may its positive appearances contract the surviving set for later heldout transitions.
layer_a.universe_falsification_rule: If no world survives during calibration, paired prediction is non-estimable and no model is fit. If no world survives after a heldout score, later heldout units are not fabricated and the paired endpoint is incomplete/non-confirmatory.
layer_a.interpretation: exact finite structural source-exposure worlds; thresholds are analyst-choice regimes, not calibrated roe-deer dispersal distances

layer_b.no_tuning: No Layer-B feature selection, transformation or outcome-specific tuning is permitted.

strong_baseline.hyperparameter_provenance: Reuses the frozen strong-RF policy from the Glanville EOG validation; no roe-deer response tuning.
strong_baseline.fit_policy: fit once to pooled calibration candidate rows; do not refit on heldout outcomes
strong_baseline.study_area_prefix_rule: first three ASCII letters of frozen Station ID; the retained station registry uses the ten externally interpretable prefixes TAC,TAR,TBA,TDA,TEL,TIL,TKA,TKG,TTO,TUL, matching the published narea=10 structure
strong_baseline.preprocessing: Fail closed on missing/non-finite frozen static numeric predictors. Encode frozen response-independent categorical levels with deterministic one-hot columns sorted lexicographically; no response-derived feature selection or scaling is applied to RF inputs.
strong_baseline.scientific_strength: Contains spatial coordinates, habitat/topography/anthropogenic predictors, ten-area structure, season, camera effort and lagged detection history. This is intentionally at least as information-rich as a simple local/environment-only baseline.

augmented_model.forbidden_difference: No learner, hyperparameter, preprocessing, split, target or conventional-feature change between paired fits.

metric_and_decision.favorable_rule: augmented macro logloss < baseline macro logloss and augmented wins at least 4 of 5 heldout transitions
metric_and_decision.adverse_rule: baseline macro logloss < augmented macro logloss and baseline wins at least 4 of 5 heldout transitions
